note: Runtime overrides merged on top of wuwa-data.json. Hand-edit between full preprocess re-runs. Each array block targets the same array in the baseline and merges by id. Entries with new IDs are ADDED; entries with existing IDs are merged (override specific fields only). See src/data/loader.js for merge semantics.

resonator_schema._comment: Template for manually adding resonators not yet in Dimbreath or nanoka.

_fields.id: integer — in-game role ID (check Dimbreath RoleInfo or nanoka URL)
_fields.name: string — display name e.g. Sigrika
_fields.propertyId: null (stat curve not available from manual entry)
_fields.elementColor: hex color (copy from ELEMENT_COLORS in preprocess.mjs)
